description: Magic edits by ops (contracts/README.md, Magic: edits by ops): each case's ops applied in order, all or nothing, to a document; `expect` is the document after the last op or {error, op_index}. Replayed through studio_service/api/magic (go test TestMagicReplay) and web_service/lib/magic.ts (replay_magic.mjs) by check.py.

cases.description: add, insert: pushes what is after along; the music tied to the run stretches; the dissolve no longer meets
add, insert inside a block: it goes to that block's end
add, overwrite inside a block: it splits it, the new parts take fresh ids
add, overwrite across two blocks trims both
add on an empty lane at a point
add with an id in use is refused
add on a lane that is gone is refused
move, insert: Shot 3 to the start; the line tied to Shot 1 follows it
move, overwrite: Shot 1 later onto Shot 2's time
move, overwrite into the middle of a block splits it
move past the end leaves a gap
move two blocks to another lane
move blocks of two lanes onto one is refused

expect.error: Move blocks from one lane at a time.

cases.description: move blocks of two lanes along their own lanes
move nothing that exists is refused
trim the end of Shot 1: nothing else moves
trim the start of Shot 3 later
trim over the next block is refused

expect.error: It would cover the block next to it.

cases.description: delete, insert: the gap closes and the tied music fits the shots left
delete, overwrite: the gap stays
delete a shot a line is tied to: the tie goes
duplicate two shots: copies go after them, pushing the rest
split Shot 2: the join after it follows the second part
split where the playhead is not on the block is refused
link Line 1 to Shot 2, then move Shot 2: the line follows
unlink, then the move leaves the line
link to itself is refused
transitions: a fade out at the lane's end with its default length, a dissolve's length changed, a cut takes one away
transition between blocks that do not meet is refused
transition naming two joins is refused
all or nothing: the second op fails, nothing applies
effects: add to two blocks, replace one, take one off
effect_set on an effect that is not there is refused
block: rename, a note, a new request, unpin
lanes: add one after Shots, rename it, hide it, move it up
lane rename to blank is refused
lane move past the top is refused
lane delete: its blocks and their ties go
lane delete of the Shots lane: its joins and the music's tie go
asset delete: its @ picks go, a voice stays as it is
